observations: Photo 0 shows a white Epson projector from the front-top angle, with the brand name 'EPSON' visible on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the top-right side of the projector, with a label clearly reading 'EB-485Wi' and control buttons including power, menu, source, and short throw indicator.
Photo 2 shows the rear panel of the projector with multiple ports: HDMI, VGA, audio, USB, and network, along with a power socket.
The projector appears to be in used condition with no visible damage in the photos.
No remote control is shown in any photo, consistent with the seller's claim.

claims.evidence: The model EB-485Wi is visible in photo 1, and it is known to be a short throw projector, but lumens specification is not visible in any photo. The seller's claim of 3000 lumens cannot be verified from the images.
The photos show signs of use such as minor surface marks and dust, consistent with a used item.
No remote control is visible in any of the photos, and the seller explicitly states this.

risks.risk: Projector may not be functional or may have lamp issues
risks.proof: A video showing the projector powering on, projecting an image, and responding to buttons (or a photo of the lamp indicator status).

risks.risk: Lamp life may be depleted or nearing end
risks.proof: Photo of the lamp hours display or a video showing the lamp status indicator.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown lamp life, which reduces value

risks.risk: Missing or damaged ports or connectors
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each port on the rear panel to confirm they are intact and not bent or corroded.

proof_requests: Video of the projector turning on and projecting an image.
Photo of the lamp hours display or lamp status indicator.
Close-up photos of all rear ports to confirm they are undamaged.
Photo of the power cable if included.
response.reason: The model is identified as Epson EB-485Wi, but critical functional claims like lumens and working condition cannot be verified from the photos. The item must be proven functional and its lamp life confirmed before pricing.
